title: Wahoo collection removal not working
body: Hey Happy Tuesday!  I have manged to get my Wahoo Bolt bike Computer working with my Dexcom G6 and Displaying my BG readings! It is great!  It is a long story on how I did it, but I am trying to remove it from my old Wahoo so whomever is using it next, won't have the Scanning message forever taking up space on the screen.  I have used Start USB Configuration command with xdrip collector disabled as suggested in the wiki, but it doesn't work.  The BG value continues to be displayed.   Part of the long story mentioned above..  and suggestions?
